base_candidate.role: frozen Nautilus execution, costs, account, external pools and current-NAV risk path

prior_failure.diagnosis: V7 repaired stale refresh ownership and receiver ATR self-normalization, but its single 0.5-to-1 sender-body and 0-to-1 parity-risk state collapsed the opportunity set to two plans. Path evidence showed that parity has two different meanings: it can remain ahead as an unfinished transfer, or the fresh receiver displacement can cross it and establish a new price-discovery leg before the FVG retracement. Treating all prior parity touches as stale discarded the second family.

research_question: Can one causal residual-receiver state support both unfinished catch-up and a fresh same-leg parity handoff, while completed transfer converts the original protective stop to a fee-covering positive lock and leaves the external-liquidity objective intact?

hypothesis.sender_state: Two distinct completed five-minute common-flow events must share exactly three accepted sender markets, produce positive median signed progress, majority advance, and majority first-origin hold. Sender impulses use only prior completed five-minute ATR.
hypothesis.effective_evidence_boundary: Every activation or accepted refresh creates a new effective evidence timestamp. A residual leg whose completed five-minute bar began at or before that timestamp is no-trade, even when the portfolio state identifier is retained.
hypothesis.information_ownership: The three accepted sender markets supplied the state evidence and remain terminal no-trade. A four-market response has no residual receiver. The sole excluded market is the only possible receiver.
hypothesis.residual_lag: At confirmation the residual market's signed log progress from the first event must be strictly less than the accepted sender median, leaving a positive delivery gap.
hypothesis.fresh_leg: The residual must independently complete a new post-evidence five-minute MSS, same-direction displacement, strict three-candle FVG and passive first consequent-encroachment retracement. Its displacement is normalized with prior completed five-minute ranges only.
hypothesis.partial_catch_up: Parity remains strictly ahead and no completed post-evidence receiver bar has consumed it. The new residual MSS/FVG leg is allowed without reusing V7's exposed sender-body interval; the independent same-leg structure and live external target continue to define executable geometry.
hypothesis.parity_handoff_retest: No earlier completed post-evidence bar consumed parity, but the current fresh receiver displacement itself trades through and closes beyond parity. That completed displacement becomes a new price-discovery leg, and only its later passive FVG retracement may enter.
hypothesis.management: After entry, a synchronized completed one-minute close at or beyond parity or the minimum fee-cover activation modifies the existing STOP_MARKET to the smallest one-tick-positive cost-cover price. The external target is not shortened, preserving right-tail delivery.
hypothesis.invalidation_and_target: The stop remains beyond the residual leg's protected swing or opposing bar and the final target remains the next causally live completed-4H or previous-day external liquidity pool. Entry, invalidation and target belong to the receiver's new leg; parity only validates the transfer stage.
hypothesis.family_isolation: V1-V3 SCDAM, SESSION_I7, accepted-market continuation, malformed receiver states, and stale parity states remain terminally rejected.
hypothesis.execution_safety: NautilusTrader owns orders and account state. A flat post-only entry rejection is terminal non-execution; any denied or rejected order while a position is open cancels remaining orders and market-closes the position. Stop modification requires exactly one open STOP_MARKET child and otherwise fail-closes.

router.progress_rule: positive median signed log return and majority advance
router.origin_rule: majority remains beyond the first confirming origins
router.tradable_market_policy: sole market excluded from current accepted_symbols
router.partial_stage: parity remains ahead with positive costed space
router.handoff_stage: current fresh displacement touches and closes beyond parity

selection.method: E01-E06 are the same fully exposed mechanism-development intervals used by V4-V7. Reuse isolates transfer-stage routing and post-entry management; it can never support a success claim.

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and can only reject or improve V8.
V6/V7 path attribution is post-hoc mechanism evidence, not success evidence.
V8 changes transfer-stage routing and management, not costs, risk sizing, global slot, invalidation or external target.
Passing development permits a source freeze and newly predeclared untouched confirmation; it is not success.

Success requires a frozen continuous Nautilus account with realistic costs, sufficient independent opportunities, no liquidation or unrecoverable damage, and project-level daily geometric growth of at least 1%.
